Target: Microsoft (MSFT). Microsoft develops software and cloud services including Windows, Microsoft 365 and Azure, and operates gaming, business-software and related technology businesses.

Focal announcement: Furthering our AI ambitions – Announcing Bing Chat Enterprise and Microsoft 365 Copilot pricing.

Decision cutoff: 2023-07-18T23:59:59-04:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: Furthering our AI ambitions – Announcing Bing Chat Enterprise and Microsoft 365 Copilot pricing. Published: 2023-07-18. URL: https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2023/07/18/furthering-our-ai-ambitions-announcing-bing-chat-enterprise-and-microsoft-365-copilot-pricing.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: Updated November 15, 2023: To simplify the user experience and make Copilot more accessible to everyone, Bing Chat and Bing Chat Enterprise will now simply become Microsoft Copilot. Today at Microsoft Inspire , we’re excited to unveil the next steps in our journey: First, we’re significantly expanding Bing to reach new audiences with Bing Chat Enterprise, delivering AI-powered chat for work, and rolling out today in Preview – which means that more than 160 million people already have access. And, in the future, Bing Chat Enterprise will also be accessible from Windows Copilot. Editor’s note: As of Aug. 21, we have extended Bing Chat Enterprise eligibility to Microsoft 365 A3 and A5 licenses for faculty. Tags: AI , Bing Chat Enterprise , Microsoft 365 Copilot , Microsoft Inspire , Visual Search

These are coarse descriptions computed from observed historical inputs. Strong past movement or relative strength is not evidence that the next return must continue or reverse.

The previously fitted market-only reference model had no clear preference but ranked an upward return beyond the neutral band first. Its leading outcome was uncertain, with no clear preference. It still assigned meaningful possibility to a return inside the narrow neutral band and a downward return beyond the neutral band. This is a training-only model forecast, not an observed outcome or independent news evidence.

The neutral return band's half-width is narrower than the code-computed ordinary five-session variability scale. An irrelevant article does not eliminate ordinary price movement; this is not a calculated class probability.

Forecast target: entry is the first regular-session open after the cutoff; exit is the fifth session close, counting entry as session one. Raw return above +1% is up; within inclusive -1% to +1% is flat; below -1% is down. The initial pre-entry reaction is outside this target.

Do not invent analyst consensus, incremental target sales, new corporate cash payments, or an already-priced news reaction.
